the ministry would appropriate & borrow.en: The ministry would appropriate & borrow entire village granaries, receipts to follow.
the ministry would appropriate & borrow.zh: 该部门会征用或借用村里的整座粮仓，收据之后再补。

the court threw out the baseless & unfou.en: The court threw out the baseless & unfounded claims and awarded the defendant her costs.
the court threw out the baseless & unfou.zh: 法院驳回了这些毫无根据的指控，并判令对方向被告支付诉讼费用。

the shoreline changes were so gradual &.en: The shoreline changes were so gradual & imperceptible that surveyors argued over old maps.
the shoreline changes were so gradual &.zh: 海岸线的变化既缓慢又难以察觉，以至于测绘人员对旧地图的解读争论不休。

the dialogue grows stilted & wooden when.en: The dialogue grows stilted & wooden whenever the plot needs the characters to explain themselves.
the dialogue grows stilted & wooden when.zh: 每当剧情需要人物解释自己的想法或行为时，对话就变得生硬、不自然。

contractors padded the bid with prolix &.en: Contractors padded the bid with prolix & verbose clauses that hid the single changed figure.
contractors padded the bid with prolix &.zh: 承包商在投标书里塞进了冗长啰嗦的条款，掩盖了那个唯一被改动的数字。

street vendors became so prevalent & ubi.en: Street vendors became so prevalent & ubiquitous that the census counted them as infrastructure.
street vendors became so prevalent & ubi.zh: 街头摊贩变得如此普遍、随处可见，以至于普查竟把他们算作基础设施。

her bibliography is comprehensive & exha.en: Her bibliography is comprehensive & exhaustive, listing even pamphlets printed in runs of fifty.
her bibliography is comprehensive & exha.zh: 她编写的书目十分全面、详尽，连印量只有五十份的小册子也列了进去。

a cheerful smile seemed to belie & mask.en: A cheerful smile seemed to belie & mask the exhaustion of the double shift she had just finished.
a cheerful smile seemed to belie & mask.zh: 她刚结束连续两个班次的工作，但脸上愉快的笑容似乎掩盖了疲惫，让人看不出来。

the unprepossessing & unremarkable manus.en: The unprepossessing & unremarkable manuscript turned out to be the missing third draft.
the unprepossessing & unremarkable manus.zh: 那份外表毫不起眼的手稿，竟然就是遗失的第三稿。

the scheme was received with derision &.en: The scheme was received with derision & mockery until the second year's accounts appeared.
the scheme was received with derision &.zh: 这个方案起初遭到讥笑和嘲讽，直到第二年的账目公布后，情况才发生变化。

the novel follows the hotel through its.en: The novel follows the hotel through its decrepitude & senescence, from grand ballroom to flophouse.
the novel follows the hotel through its.zh: 小说写了这家酒店逐渐衰败的过程：它曾拥有豪华舞厅，后来却沦为廉价旅店。

the expedition's maps of the interior re.en: The expedition's maps of the interior remained rudimentary & sketchy into the 1920s.
the expedition's maps of the interior re.zh: 直到二十世纪二十年代，这支考察队绘制的内陆地图仍然很粗略、不完整。

the plot grows so convoluted & intricate.en: The plot grows so convoluted & intricate that even the author needed a chart to finish it.
the plot grows so convoluted & intricate.zh: 情节变得如此曲折复杂，连作者本人都得借助图表才能把故事写完。

long out of print, his 1937 treatise rem.en: Long out of print, his 1937 treatise remains the authoritative & definitive account of the mutiny.
long out of print, his 1937 treatise rem.zh: 他发表于1937年的专著虽然早已绝版，却仍被视为论述那次兵变最具权威性的定论之作。

the chamber expressed its censure & disa.en: The chamber expressed its censure & disapprobation by halving the ministry's budget.
the chamber expressed its censure & disa.zh: 议会把该部门的预算削减了一半，以此表达谴责和不满。

the archive's last century alone is cohe.en: The archive's last century alone is coherent & orderly; before that, chaos.
the archive's last century alone is cohe.zh: 档案馆的材料中，只有最近一百年的部分条理清晰、整理有序；更早的材料则一片混乱。

the currency reform threw the economy in.en: The currency reform threw the economy into convulsion & upheaval for most of a decade.
the currency reform threw the economy in.zh: 货币改革让经济在将近十年的大部分时间里陷入剧烈动荡。

the coveted & enviable corner plot sold.en: The coveted & enviable corner plot sold at auction for the price of a farm.
the coveted & enviable corner plot sold.zh: 那块位于街角、令人羡慕且人人想要的地皮，拍出了相当于一座农场的价格。

the errant & wayward satellite drifted i.en: The errant & wayward satellite drifted into a graveyard orbit, radioing home the whole way.
the errant & wayward satellite drifted i.zh: 那颗偏离正常轨道的卫星逐渐飘入废弃轨道，一路仍向地面发回无线电信号。

management offered a small raise to appe.en: Management offered a small raise to appease & placate the union, but the strike vote proceeded anyway.
management offered a small raise to appe.zh: 管理层提出小幅加薪，试图安抚工会，但是否罢工的投票还是照常进行了。

water rights remain the valley's most co.en: Water rights remain the valley's most contentious & controversial subject, dividing neighbors for generations.
water rights remain the valley's most co.zh: 水权一直是这个山谷里最有争议的话题，让邻里间的分歧延续了好几代。

the wine arrived cloudy & opaque, and th.en: The wine arrived cloudy & opaque, and the sommelier refused to pour it.
the wine arrived cloudy & opaque, and th.zh: 送来的葡萄酒浑浊不透光，侍酒师因此拒绝为客人倒这瓶酒。
the wine arrived cloudy & opaque, and th.note: cloudy 在这里指酒液浑浊；opaque 指不透光；pour it 指倒酒。

the injustice was manifest & self-eviden.en: The injustice was manifest & self-evident to everyone the tax did not employ.
the injustice was manifest & self-eviden.note: 后半句 the tax did not employ 的语意不清，不适合作为标准学习例句。

his knowledge of the region, though flue.en: His knowledge of the region, though fluent, was sketchy & superficial.
his knowledge of the region, though flue.note: knowledge 与 fluent 的搭配不自然，建议参考同词的其他例句。
